summary: An early 1969 memo on host software for the ARPANET. It discusses how links between host computers might be organised, including a special control link that hosts would use to set up and break user links and to pass status messages. It is a working proposal from the earliest days of the network, not a standard.

eli5.summary: Computers on a new network needed a way to say hello and goodbye. This note suggests a special channel just for passing those little control messages.
